Agricultural loans disbursed by
Public Sector Banks
†*221. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that
Rs. 1,60,479.4 crore was disbursed as loan
by the Public Sector Banks in the rural
areas of the country by the end of March,
2005;
(b) if not, what is the actual amount;
(c) whether it is also a fact that this
amount is only 15 per cent of the total loan
given by the banks;
(d) if not, the details in this regard;
and
(e) the directions of the Reserve Bank
of India regarding the percentage of
agricultural loan to be made available?
Revision in fuel prices on monthly basis
*222. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering revision of fuel price in each
month;
(b) the break-up of basic price and tax
on per litre of petrol and diesel as on
30th June, 2006; and
(c) the details of the other countries
which have so far revised the petrol and
diesel price upwardly in recent past?

going to be merged; and

Selection of Independent Directors
*225. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of HEAVY

ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of vacancies of
Independent Directors existing at present,
PSE-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that such
positions have remained vacant for years,
if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that absence of

them under the Policy;

*226. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:

private airlines owe huge sum of money to
Airports Authority of India (AAI);
(b) if so, the details thereof;

the period of default;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and

Allocation of natural gas to Andhra
Pradesh
*227. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) what are the quantities of oil and
natural gas found so far in Andhra Pradesh
during the last two years;
(b) what are the quantities allocated to
the State Government and the State
industries;
(c) what are the quantities exploited so
far; and
(d) whether there is any proposal to
provide a fixed allocation of these two
resources to the State?

Crude production target
†*230. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have fixed any
target for production of crude oil in the
country for the year 2006-07;

Committee on modernisation of
airports
*231. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set up a
Tripartite Committee to look into the issues
and proposals of modernising airports by
Airports Authority of India as assured by
him vide his letter dated 4th February,
2006;;
(b) if so, whether the above issues
including the modernisation of Delhi and
Mumbai airports had been discussed in the
Committee;
(c) if so, whether the Committee has
submitted its report within three months
as stipulated; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Diesel/petrol seized by customs/DRI
*232. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that custom
officials seized a tanker on 24th May, 2006

71
in Mumbai trying to smuggle over a huge
quantity of highly inflammable material into
the country;
(b) the total quantity of diesel and
petrol seized in the financial year 2005-06
by Directorate of Revenue Intelligence
(DRI) in India;
(c) whether it is a fact that large quantity
of the imported fuel like kerosene finds is
used to adulterate petrol and diesel in India;

Marking of kerosene
*233. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry,
in a serious bid to curb a large scale
adulteration of petroleum products, would
implement marking of kerosene in the first
phase, across the country from October
1st;
(b) whether it is also a fact that Oil
Marketing Companies (OMCs) would
introduce marking of potential adulterants
at refineries/manufacturing units and import
locations all over the country; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Insufficient labour force in banks
*234. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the recently released Asian
Banking Outlook-2006 by Moody's
Investor Service has commented on the
inflexible and inefficient labour force in
Indian Public Sector Banks blunting their
competitive edge with private sector banks;
(b) whether during the frequent wage
revision negotiations with the bank
employee unions, the Indian Banks
Association has even attempted to link
remunerative package to productivity and
efficiency;
(c) whether despite this low work
output, Government are considering to
introduce Employee Stock Option Schemes
for the bank employees; and
(d) if so, the rationale and details
thereof?

grant financial allocation to heavy industries
set up in NER?

 Will the Minister of FINANCE be

World Bank assistance to GAIL
*240. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA : Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be

the offer; and

projects are likely to start?
